decisions.reason: "Servants" of a king are his court officials, so Balanced and Readable say "officials", as Isaiah does. The name keeps the form Nebuchadrezzar, as in verses 2 and 13.

decisions.choice: Egypt will be lived in again (Balanced); people will live in Egypt again (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Egypt as the subject (m2) and say plainly that "dwell" here means being inhabited.

source.text: וְ֠אַתָּה אַל־תִּירָ֞א עַבְדִּ֤י יַֽעֲקֹב֙ וְאַל־תֵּחַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י הִנְנִ֤י מוֹשִֽׁעֲךָ֙ מֵֽרָח֔וֹק וְאֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֖ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ שִׁבְיָ֑ם וְשָׁ֧ב יַעֲק֛וֹב וְשָׁקַ֥ט וְשַׁאֲנַ֖ן וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And you, do not fear, my servant Jacob, and do not be dismayed, Israel; for look, I [am] saving you from afar, and your offspring from [the] land of their captivity; and Jacob will return and be quiet and be at ease, and there [will be] none making [him] afraid.

en.L: And you, do not fear, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Jacob, and do not be dismayed, Israel, \q for look, I am saving you from far away, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. \q And Jacob will return and be quiet and at ease, and there will be no one to make [him] afraid.
en.B: But you, Jacob {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, do not be afraid; do not be dismayed, Israel. \q For I will save you from a far country, and your descendants from the land where they are captives. \q Jacob will come home and have quiet and rest, and no one will make him afraid.
en.R: But do not be afraid, Jacob, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant. Israel, do not be frightened. \q I will save you from a land far away. I will save your children from the land where they are prisoners. \q The people of Jacob will come home. They will live in peace and safety, and no one will frighten them.

es.L: Pero tú, no temas, siervo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}} Jacob, ni te espantes, Israel, \q porque he aquí, yo te salvo de lejos, y a tu descendencia de la tierra de su cautiverio. \q Y Jacob volverá, y estará tranquilo y seguro, y no habrá quien [lo] atemorice.
es.B: Pero tú, Jacob, siervo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, no tengas miedo; no te espantes, Israel. \q Porque yo te salvaré de un país lejano, y a tus descendientes de la tierra donde están cautivos. \q Jacob volverá a casa y tendrá tranquilidad y reposo, y nadie lo atemorizará.
es.R: Pero no tengas miedo, Jacob, siervo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}. Israel, no te asustes. \q Yo te salvaré de una tierra lejana. Salvaré a tus hijos de la tierra donde están prisioneros. \q El pueblo de Jacob volverá a casa. Vivirá en paz y seguridad, y nadie lo asustará.

sw.L: Nawe, usiogope, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Yakobo, wala usifadhaike, Israeli, \q kwa maana tazama, ninakuokoa kutoka mbali, na uzao wako kutoka nchi ya utumwa wao. \q Naye Yakobo atarudi na kutulia na kustarehe, wala hakuna atakayemtia hofu.
sw.B: Basi wewe, Yakobo mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, usiogope; usifadhaike, Israeli. \q Kwa maana nitakuokoa kutoka nchi ya mbali, na wazao wako kutoka nchi wanamoshikiliwa mateka. \q Yakobo atarudi nyumbani na kupata utulivu na raha, wala hakuna atakayemtia hofu.
sw.R: Basi usiogope, Yakobo, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Israeli, usitishike. \q Nitakuokoa kutoka nchi ya mbali. Nitawaokoa watoto wako kutoka nchi wanamoshikiliwa kama wafungwa. \q Watu wa Yakobo watarudi nyumbani. Wataishi kwa amani na usalama, wala hakuna atakayewatisha.

decisions.choice: do not fear, my servant Jacob: the words of 30:10, repeated here
decisions.reason: Verses 27-28 repeat 30:10-11 almost word for word, and the wording here follows those verses. Verse 27 differs in one point: 30:10 has "declares the LORD" after "my servant Jacob", and here it is missing (it comes in verse 28). After the oracle against Egypt, the promise turns to Israel: the nation it trusted will fall, but God's people will come home.

decisions.choice: my servant: Israel as the people the LORD has chosen and keeps
decisions.reason: As in 30:10. It is a title of honor, not of bondage (Isaiah 41:8-9; 44:1-2).

decisions.choice: I am saving you from far away: a sure promise, spoken as if already under way
decisions.reason: As in 30:10.

decisions.choice: the wording of 30:10
decisions.reason: The levels keep the wording of 30:10 so that a reader hears the same promise in both places, leaving out only "declares the LORD" (m1). Balanced and Readable begin "But" rather than the "So" of 30:10, because here the promise is set against Egypt's fate.

decisions.choice: The people of Jacob ... They ... them
decisions.reason: As in 30:10.

decisions.choice: the wording of 30:10
decisions.reason: Verses 27-28 repeat 30:10-11, and the Spanish of that passage is reused at each level. Here the Hebrew has no "declares the LORD" in the first line, and verse 28 differs as noted there.

decisions.choice: the Swahili wording of 30:10-11 at each level, reused for 46:27-28
decisions.reason: The promise to Jacob repeats 30:10-11; the same Swahili lets a reader see it, and only what the Hebrew changes is changed: no "declares the LORD" in 46:27, and 46:28 opens with "do not fear" and says "where I have driven you" ("nilikokufukuzia") for "scattered".

records.literal_gloss: You, do not fear, my servant Jacob, declares Yahweh, for with you I [am]; for I will make [a] full end of all the nations where I have driven you there, but you I will not make [a] full end [of]; and I will discipline you in justice, and leaving unpunished I will not leave you unpunished.

en.L: You, do not fear, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Jacob, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for I [am] with you. \q For I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you, but of you I will not make a full end. \q I will discipline you in just measure, \q and I will by no means leave you unpunished.
en.B: You, Jacob {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, do not be afraid, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because I am with you. \q I will bring to an end all the nations among whom I drove you, but you I will not bring to an end. \q I will discipline you, but justly, \q and I will not let you go unpunished.
en.R: Do not be afraid, Jacob, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I am with you. \q I will completely destroy all the nations where I drove you. But I will not completely destroy you. \q I will correct you, but I will be fair, \q and I will not let you escape all punishment.

es.L: Tú, no temas, siervo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}} Jacob, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque yo [estoy] contigo. \q Porque acabaré del todo con todas las naciones adonde te he arrojado, pero contigo no acabaré del todo. \q Te corregiré con justa medida, \q y de ninguna manera te dejaré sin castigo.
es.B: Tú, Jacob, siervo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, no tengas miedo, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque yo estoy contigo. \q Acabaré con todas las naciones adonde te arrojé, pero contigo no acabaré. \q Te corregiré, pero con justicia, \q y no te dejaré sin castigo.
es.R: No tengas miedo, Jacob, siervo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Yo estoy contigo. \q Destruiré por completo a todas las naciones adonde te arrojé. Pero a ti no te destruiré por completo. \q Te corregiré, pero seré justo, \q y no dejaré que te libres de todo castigo.

sw.L: Wewe, usiogope, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Yakobo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] pamoja nawe. \q Kwa maana nitayakomesha kabisa mataifa yote nilikokufukuzia, lakini wewe sitakukomesha kabisa. \q Nitakurudi kwa kipimo cha haki, \q wala sitakuacha kamwe bila adhabu.
sw.B: Wewe, Yakobo mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, usiogope, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niko pamoja nawe. \q Nitayamaliza kabisa mataifa yote ambamo nilikufukuzia, lakini wewe sitakumaliza. \q Nitakuadibisha, lakini kwa haki, \q wala sitakuacha bila adhabu.
sw.R: Usiogope, Yakobo, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Mimi niko pamoja nawe. \q Nitayaangamiza kabisa mataifa yote nilikokufukuzia. Lakini wewe sitakuangamiza kabisa. \q Nitakurekebisha, lakini nitakuwa wa haki, \q wala sitakuacha uepuke adhabu yote.

decisions.choice: the words of 30:11, with three differences
decisions.reason: The verse follows 30:11 closely. It differs in three places. It opens by repeating "do not fear, my servant Jacob" with "declares the LORD", which here moves from verse 27. It says "for I am with you" without the words "to save you" that follow in 30:11. And it says "where I have driven you" where 30:11 has "where I have scattered you". It also joins "but you I will not make a full end" with a plain "and" where 30:11 has a stronger "only". The promise is the same.

decisions.choice: a full end: complete destruction
decisions.reason: As in 30:11.

decisions.choice: discipline you in justice: correct you in fair measure, not to destroy you
decisions.reason: As in 30:11 (compare 10:24).

decisions.choice: leaving unpunished I will not leave you unpunished: I will certainly not let you go free of punishment
decisions.reason: As in 30:11.

decisions.choice: the wording of 30:11; driven (Literal); drove (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The levels keep the wording of 30:11 wherever the Hebrew is the same, and change only where it differs (m1): the repeated opening, "I am with you" on its own, and "driven" or "drove" for "scattered".

decisions.choice: I will correct you, but I will be fair
decisions.reason: As in 30:11.

decisions.choice: the wording of 30:11
decisions.reason: The Spanish of 30:11 is kept where the Hebrew is the same. Here the verse opens with "do not fear, my servant Jacob" and has no "to save you". It also has "where I have driven you" (arrojado) where 30:11 has "scattered".
